signatures.description: Implement safe leader transfer and step-down for a Raft replica that is midway through a joint configuration C_old,new. Requirement: while the joint entry is unapplied on a majority, commit index must never advance using a bare C_new majority, and a leader that applies the joint entry then loses contact with a C_old voter must stop committing rather than campaign under C_new alone. Cover the interleaving where a stale C_new-only configuration entry from a previous term arrives before the joint entry and must be rejected, not truncated into the log.
